page_head.title: Steady work. Real growth. A team that has your back.
page_head.intro: NC Falcon connects skilled electricians with consistent opportunities across the Carolinas. Apply once, and we'll match you to work that fits your experience.

why.title: We treat our electricians like family
why.intro: We come from the field. We know steady work and fair treatment matter — so that's what we deliver.

cards.title: Consistent Work
cards.text: We keep our electricians busy with opportunities matched to your skill level and location.

cards.title: Professional Growth
cards.text: Helper to foreman — we want to see you advance, and we connect you with work that builds your career.

cards.title: Direct Communication
cards.text: You talk to real people who answer fast and follow through. No runaround.

cards.title: Carolinas & Beyond
cards.text: Work across NC & SC, with opportunities nationwide and possible per diem depending on the project.

cards.title: Fair Pay
cards.text: Competitive rates that respect your skills and experience.

cards.title: Relationships First
cards.text: We invest in the people we place. You're not a number here.

positions.title: Positions at every level
positions.intro: Wherever you are in your career, we have opportunities for you.

apply.title: Start your application
apply.notice: Every applicant hears back within 24 hours.
